metadata.title: Robinhood Expands Private Market Push With Y Combinator-Focused Venture Fund<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Robinhood Markets deepened its push into private markets with the launch on Thursday of its second venture fund, Robinhood Ventures Fund II, which provides investors with access to private companies.
